value.name: Asha steadies herself before speaking
value.description: Asha adjusts the rate sheet on her lap and prepares to speak to Marcus without waking her father.
evidence: ut waking him, and shifted the folded rate sheet on her lap until it sat squared against her thigh.
her father's hand bare on the sheet beside her

value.name: Asha admits she cannot do it alone
value.description: Asha tells Marcus she cannot handle the situation by herself, speaking more plainly and quietly than she intended.
evidence: "I can't do this alone, Marcus," she said into the phone
the words came out flatter and quieter than she had rehearsed

value.name: Rosa prompts Asha to use a shared memory
value.description: Rosa sends Asha a line urging her to remind Marcus of the smell of rain they once shared.
evidence: her phone buzzed again under the edge of the blanket with Rosa's next line—tell him you remember the smell of the rain together.

value.name: Asha withholds Rosa's suggested line
value.description: Asha reads Rosa's prompt but stays silent, keeping the call open while waiting for Marcus to respond.
evidence: She read it without moving and did not say it yet; she only kept the line open
and waited for whatever Marcus was finally going to let himself say.

value.name: Asha asks Marcus for help with costs
value.description: Asha finally states that she needs Marcus's help paying the costs, which leaves her feeling emotionally emptied.
evidence: "Marcus, I need your help with the costs."
Saying it that plainly emptied something out of her chest

value.name: Asha confronts her father's condition
value.description: Seeing her father's slack mouth on the pillow pushes Asha to abandon softer wording and speak directly.
evidence: she had spent the cab ride composing softer versions and none of them had survived the sight of her father's slack mouth on the pillow

value.name: Rosa urges Asha to read Marcus's tone
value.description: Rosa sends another prompt telling Asha that Marcus's voice is changing and that he is letting go of his pride.
evidence: the phone buzzed again under the blanket with Rosa's next line—listen to the shift in his voice, he's letting go of the pride—

value.name: Marcus softens and asks to see the sheet
value.description: Marcus exhales and speaks more roughly than before, asking Asha to read him the contents of the rate sheet.
evidence: Marcus exhaled, a long one this time, and then his voice came through rougher than she remembered, asking her to read him what the sheet actually said.

value.description: Asha begins unfolding the rate sheet so she can read its details to Marcus.
